title: Infinity Cheer & Tumbling
specs: State-of-the-art facility with multiple cheer floors, trampolines, tumble traks, ninja course, and more
blurb: Guests can book private tumbling lessons that are 30 minutes long. The facility offers a variety of cheer and tumbling equipment including spring cheer floors, trampolines, tumble traks, and a ninja course. A Pro Shop is available on site for cheerleading and tumbling apparel needs.
extraNote: $15 booking fee plus $30 coach’s fee paid to coach through Venmo or cash upon arrival · EFT Cancellation Form requires 30 day notice
